caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular box with a rounded lid, both of which are decorated with a repeating pattern. The main motif of the pattern consists of three human figures: two men in light brown/tan clothing with hats are each holding one arm of a woman dressed in a light reddish-pink dress with a green hat, lifting her off the ground. The figures are set against a simplified landscape background with green trees and grass. The box and lid are cream-colored, and the decorative scene is surrounded by additional ornamental elements, including green scrolls, pink diamond shapes, and green foliage. The edge of the lid features a border pattern of alternating red and green geometric shapes. The overall composition gives the impression of a decorative, possibly fabric-covered, box with repeated scenic and ornamental designs.
title: Bandbox
